facts.statement: The type species Planocrania datangensis was named in 1976 from fossils found in Nanxiong, Guangdong Province, China.
facts.quote: The type species, Planocrania datangensis, was named in 1976 from material found from Nanxiong in Guangdong Province, China

facts.statement: The second species, Planocrania hengdongensis, was described in 1984 from fossils found in Hengdong County, Hunan Province.
facts.quote: A second species, Planocrania hengdongensis, is known from Hengdong County in Hunan Province and was described in 1984.

facts.statement: A 2013 analysis suggested Planocrania is closely related to Boverisuchus, leading to the reinstatement of the family Planocraniidae.
facts.quote: However, in a 2013 phylogenetic analysis, the two Asian species of Planocrania were found to be most closely related to the North American and European Boverisuchus, and the family Planocraniidae was reinstated to contain these genera and replace Pristichampsidae.

facts.statement: A 2018 study using molecular and morphological data recovered Planocraniidae outside the crown group Crocodylia.
facts.quote: A 2018 tip dating study by Lee & Yates using both molecular, morphological and stratigraphic data instead recovered the planocraniids outside crown group Crocodylia.

facts.statement: Planocrania lived between 60.9 and 56 million years ago during the Selandian to Thanetian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Selandian to Thanetian (60.9 to 56 million years ago)
